title: WorkApplicationWriteRequest
description: work.application-write-request@1: bodies of work.application.manage. POST /api/v1/me/applications takes a listing_id (title, company and URL are copied from the listing; a second POST for the same listing answers the existing application with 200) or title + company + url by hand. PATCH /api/v1/me/applications/:id takes status, notes, applied_at, next_step and next_step_at; a status change appends an event, and status applied with no applied_at stamps it now. Unknown fields are 400.
